who_for: An air fryer is great if you want crispy food with less oil and less waiting than a full oven. It's especially handy for frozen foods, vegetables, and reheating leftovers.
Size matters most. A 4- to 5-quart basket suits one or two people. Families should look at 6 quarts or more, or a dual-basket model that cooks two foods at once.

how_we_picked.label: Even cooking
how_we_picked.text: We favored models that crisp food evenly without much shaking or flipping, based on expert reviews and owner reports.

how_we_picked.label: Capacity
how_we_picked.text: We matched basket size to household size, and weighed toaster-oven styles for people who want one appliance to do more.

how_we_picked.label: Ease of cleaning
how_we_picked.text: Nonstick, dishwasher-safe baskets that are easy to clean make a big difference over time.

how_we_picked.label: Controls
how_we_picked.text: We looked for clear controls and useful presets, not a crowded panel of buttons.

how_we_picked.label: Footprint
how_we_picked.text: Air fryers take counter space, so we compared each model's size to its capacity.
